false_assumption.statement: The murder was committed by one of the Wheeler family members who confessed.
false_assumption.why_it_seems_reasonable: All three Wheelers confessed to the crime, and no other suspects were apparent. Their motives and opportunity were clear, making them the natural suspects.
false_assumption.what_it_hides: It conceals the fact that an outsider, Curtis Keefe, orchestrated the murder and manipulated the family and witnesses to confess falsely.

mechanism_description: Curtis Keefe orchestrated the murder by setting a fire to create a distraction. During the commotion, he slipped away briefly and shot Samuel Appleby through the bay window from the south veranda. To mislead the investigation, Keefe fabricated the story of a bugler and coerced or bribed witnesses to support false confessions and a fake signed confession from John Mills. His motive was political ambition and to secure his inheritance.

discriminating_test.design: Reconstruct the bullet trajectory and correlate it with the positions of Wheeler and Maida at the time of the shooting. Verify the presence and movements of Keefe during the fire distraction using witness statements and physical evidence such as the location of the revolver and the timing of the fire. Cross-check the authenticity and circumstances of the signed confession by John Mills with hospital records and witness testimonies.
discriminating_test.knowledge_revealed: This test reveals that the shot could only have come from the veranda where Keefe was briefly present, disproving Wheeler and Maida's confessions. It also exposes the fabricated confession and staged evidence orchestrated by Keefe.
discriminating_test.pass_condition: The bullet trajectory and witness testimonies exclude Wheeler and Maida as shooters, and the confession of John Mills is proven false by his incapacity and bribery evidence.
